name: Fresh Yellowtail (Hamachi) Nigiri (2 Pieces)
whyItWorks: Pristine raw yellowtail over lightly seasoned white rice provides clean protein and anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids without any roughage, dairy, or harsh spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for nigiri without wasabi smeared underneath. Dip lightly in regular or low-sodium soy sauce.
